```c
// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (50x256x512).
// Optimization: double-buffered scale staging to overlap host memcpy with accelerator mvin.
void solution(void) {
  // Double buffers for scale staging (indexed by cur/nxt)
  // Each buffer holds GK groups of BLK scale bytes for A and B.
  static uint8_t A_s_buf[2][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];
  static uint8_t B_s_buf[2][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];

  int cur = 0, nxt = 1;

  // --- PROLOG: stage scales for the very first block (i0=0, j0=0) ---
  // Only do this if there is at least one valid block to process.
  if (BLOCKS_M > 0 && BLOCKS_N > 0) {
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
      memcpy(A_s_buf[cur][g], &A_scales_row[g][0 * BLK], BLK);
      memcpy(B_s_buf[cur][g], &B_scales_col[g][0 * BLK], BLK);
    }
  }

  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
      // Partial last M/N block: compute only the real rows/cols, pad the rest.
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
      if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
      if (mrows <= 0) continue;
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK;
      if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;
      if (ncols <= 0) continue;

      int tiles   = BLK / DIM;
      int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
      uint32_t a_base = 0;
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles * tiles_K * DIM;
      int SPAD_DEST   = 128;
      int pad_i = BLK - mrows, pad_j = BLK - ncols;

      // PROF accel
      gemmini_flush(0);

      // Step 1: Configure execution (must precede scale loads).
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
                                  1, 1, 0, 0, false,
                                  /*act_mx_fmt*/0, /*wgt_mx_fmt*/0,
                                  /*out_mx_fmt*/3, /*uselut*/0);

      // Step 2: Load scale factors for CURRENT block (already staged in cur buffer).
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s_buf[cur], A_S_BYTES, 0); // sel=0 → A scales
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s_buf[cur], B_S_BYTES, 1); // sel=1 → B scales

      // --- Prefetch: compute NEXT block index and stage its scales into nxt buffer.
      //     This CPU-side memcpy runs while the accelerator processes the mvin
      //     commands issued below, hiding the staging latency. ---
      int j0_next = j0 + 1, i0_next = i0;
      if (j0_next >= BLOCKS_N) {
        j0_next = 0;
        i0_next = i0 + 1;
      }
      if (i0_next < BLOCKS_M) {
        // Clamp j0_next to a valid column block for the purposes of staging.
        int j0_nxt_clamped = (j0_next < BLOCKS_N) ? j0_next : 0;
        for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
          memcpy(A_s_buf[nxt][g], &A_scales_row[g][i0_next * BLK], BLK);
          memcpy(B_s_buf[nxt][g], &B_scales_col[g][j0_nxt_clamped * BLK], BLK);
        }
      }

      // Step 3 (no LUT needed for fp8, uselut=0): skip gemmini_mx_load_lut.

      // Step 4: MVIN tiles of A into the scratchpad.
      // A rows: stride = MATMUL_K bytes (one full row of A).
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin(
              (void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
              a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM,
              DIM, DIM);

      // MVIN tiles of B into the scratchpad.
      // B rows: stride = MATMUL_N bytes (one full row of B).
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles; j++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin2(
              (void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
              b_base + (k * tiles + j) * DIM,
              DIM, DIM);

      // Step 5: Configure requantized mvout.
      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors,
                                   /*i_bound*/tiles, /*j_bound*/tiles,
                                   /*k_bound*/tiles_K,
                                   /*scale_act_sel*/0, /*scale_w_sel*/0,
                                   /*lut_update_granularity*/1);

      // Step 6: Compute the weight-stationary tiled matmul.
      // gemmini_loop_ws_spad internally issues funct 24 (LOOP_WS_CONFIG_SPAD_AB)
      // before funct 8 (LOOP_WS), satisfying the one-shot marker requirement.
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles, tiles, tiles_K,
                           pad_i, pad_j, 0,
                           a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS,
                           0, SPAD_DEST,
                           false, false,
                           false, false, false,
                           NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0,
                           false, 0x38);

      // Step 7: Drain BF16-packed results from mx_smem to DRAM, row by row.
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++)
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(
            &C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][(j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD],
            SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * BLK,
            ncols);

      // Full memory barrier: must complete before host reads output.
      gemmini_fence();

      // Swap cur <-> nxt for the next iteration so the prefetched
      // scales become the "current" scales without any extra copy.
      int tmp = cur;
      cur = nxt;
      nxt = tmp;
    }
  }
}
```
